summary.en: Separate the capture medium from the way a finished picture is delivered.
summary.zh-cn: 把拍摄时的记录介质与成品输出方式分开。

boundary.en: Film, digital capture and instant output can coexist across a device’s workflow. A pinhole describes how light enters to form an image. Look separately at the material or sensor that receives that light.
boundary.zh-cn: 同一台设备可以先数码拍摄，再输出到即显胶片。针孔描述光线怎样进入相机并成像，记录介质要另外看光线落在哪种材料或传感器上。

en: Start at the moment of capture. With film, light forms a latent image that becomes visible through chemical development. With digital capture, a sensor converts light into signals that become image data.

Then ask how you get a picture you can view or hold. Roll film is developed later. An instant-film sheet can develop after ejection. A hybrid camera can save a digital image first and print a selected image afterward.
zh-cn: 先看拍摄时光线落在哪里。用胶片拍摄时，光线在胶片上留下潜影，经过化学显影才看得到图像。数码拍摄时，传感器将光转成信号，形成图像数据。
再问怎样得到能看的照片。普通胶卷在拍摄后冲洗，即显胶片可以在出片后显影。混合式相机可以先保存数码照片，再选择一张输出。
